title: limonium macropterum
intro: Limonium macropterum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Statice, is a flowering plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, promote relaxation, and soothe digestive issues.
